body:
The link to the Threat Modeling project pages
https://owasp.org/www-project-threat-model/
is now 
https://owasp.org/www-project-threat-modeling/
to align with the project name of 'Threat Modeling'

This link was changed more than 3 weeks ago so I am not sure why this was not picked up in the ASVS project link-checker github action:
[URL Checker](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/actions/workflows/url-checker.yml)
which ran on November 30th and did not detect this broken link

comments.body: I can create a PR for this if you want to assign it to me, thanks!
Thanks for the heads up, I just noticed the link checker failed so I opened #3311 to address this

title: Broken link to Threat Modeling project not picked up by URL check action
